en.title: Former Israeli hostage Amit Soussana was sexually assaulted in Gaza by her captor
en.description: Israeli lawyer Amit Soussana was kidnapped from her home on October 7th. Soussana testified in a NY Times interview that she was sexually assaulted by her captor. (Source: https://www.nytimes.com/2024/03/26/world/middleeast/hamas-hostage-sexual-assault.html )
